name: はじまりの壁画洞窟
notes: The deep gallery keeps approximately 11 m width and 5.5 m centre headroom up to the back chamber. Existing measured source relief is expanded without moving the accepted mouth or replacing the cave with primitive geometry.
Only the final 1.2 m rounds into a broad rear wall; the long tapered dead end is removed. The source boundary vertices remain shared across the wall, floor and ceiling joins.
The measured aisle is 54.91 m, 2.11 times the original 26.00 m. The original outdoor campfire, river, mountain mesh and castle path are unchanged.

Sixteen wall paintings form two animal groups with the same mammoth, bison, deer and two horses in different orders. The left group includes the cat; the right group includes 524, with animals on both sides of each character.

The separate transparent 524 pigment closely preserves the user image silhouette, ears, lower lobes, two drops, three white patches, exact digits and dark mouth. Its generated PNG is copied unchanged; other accepted animal art is retained.
White calcite wall albedo retains real rock relief, pores and bedding; pigments are projected directly onto those existing triangles. Warm fire illuminates the same faintly visible paintings.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS.2 (GGUF/C++), 1024 geometry, seed 42, 512 texture flow, 2048 atlas
provenance.workflow: Source image → TRELLIS.2 → source-preserving QEM → terrain fitting/UV/materials → exact GLB QA → source-shell refinement and measured walk surface

pigment.application: Sixteen placements, eight on each wall: matching mammoth, bison, deer and two horse motifs in different orders, with the cat on the left and a separate faithful 524 pigment on the right.

rockSurface.application: White calcite limestone colour with 2.8m triplanar pores, bedding and surface-gradient relief, mineral mottling and damp roughness; warm fire reveals the pigments on the same triangles.

characterPigment.application: Faithful 524 silhouette, digits, white face circles, mouth and two drops; one transparent ochre-pigment image projected into the right wall animal group. Generated PNG is copied unchanged.
